324.speaker: Player_Romus
324.text: "Please don't make this difficult. Just sign your name and get this over with."

325.speaker: Player_Romus
325.text: "You can't come out of this looking like a martyr. We'll make you sign the papers, just as we did with the General."

326.speaker: Player_Romus
326.text: "Fine. Titus, you heard her. Arrest Angelica Sazon immediately."

329.speaker: Player_Romus
329.text: "I don't have time for this. Titus, shoot her."

334.speaker: Player_Romus
334.text: "Titus. Give her the same treatment as the good General."

335.speaker: Narrator
335.text: Titus gave the signal to his men.

339.speaker: Narrator
339.text: Just as with Taddeus, they brought Angelica to the desk and forced a pen into her hand.

341.speaker: Narrator
341.text: Despite Angelica's best efforts, she was forced to sign.

345.speaker: Narrator
345.text: The Wruhec's Guardians brought Angelica to the desk and pressed the pen firmly into her grip.

346.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
346.text: "Guardians, you know what to do. Move!"

348.speaker: Narrator
348.text: Titus gave the signal to Sevrio.

356.speaker: Narrator
356.text: Without a moment of hesitation, Titus signaled to Sevrio, who grabbed Angelica and guided her toward the back wall, where his men took her into custody.

357.speaker: Narrator
357.text: Titus gave his men the signal.

361.speaker: Narrator
361.text: Just as with Taddeus, they brought Leona to the desk and forced a pen into her hand.

363.speaker: Narrator
363.text: Despite Leona's best efforts, she was forced to sign.

364.speaker: Narrator
364.text: Without missing a beat, the Wruhec's Guardians brought Leona to the desk and pressed the pen firmly into her grip.

368.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
368.text: "Guardians, you know what to do. Move!"

369.speaker: Narrator
369.text: Titus gave the signal to Sevrio.

376.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
376.text: "May she find redemption in the afterlife."

382.speaker: Manus Sazon
382.text: "And in the end, these titles and land aren't really ours to give away, are they? What did either of us do to deserve them?"

386.speaker: Player_Romus
386.text: "Why would I? You're still the Prince Consort."

388.speaker: Leona Sazon
388.text: "Signing our family's fate away? You're no Sazon at all."

389.speaker: Leona Sazon
389.text: "But I know when I'm outnumbered. I won't put up a fight."

390.speaker: Player_Romus
390.text: "I'll remind you that you're vastly outnumbered. Think very carefully about your next steps."

392.speaker: Narrator
392.text: With a long sigh of regret, she lowered her hand again and signed the document.

394.speaker: Narrator
394.text: With a long sigh of regret, she lowered her hand again and scribbled her signature on the document.

399.speaker: Manus Sazon
399.text: "Not everything. We still have each other."

400.speaker: Leona Sazon
400.text: "I hope you're happy, Your Majesty. You've taken everything and everyone from me."

403.speaker: Leona Sazon
403.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. And Manus, I am so sorry."
